title: El sistema proporcional, la circunscripción provincial y la Junta Electoral
goal: Understand how votes translate into seats in Spain: the province as electoral district ('circunscripción electoral'), proportional representation (D'Hondt method), and the Junta Electoral Central.
grammar: Using 'en proporción a' and 'con arreglo a' to describe seat allocation and legal formulas.

items: Understand how votes translate into seats in Spain: the province as electoral district ('circunscripción electoral'), proportional representation (D'Hondt method), and the Junta Electoral Central.
